title: Late October — Lead-in
description: The November 4-day split at low effort, to learn the lifts and find your starting weights. Rotate A → B → C → D → A → B before 1 Nov.
whatsNew: Same four days as November: Chest & Triceps, Legs, Back & Biceps, Shoulders & Hinge.
2 sets per exercise, leaving 4 reps in the tank (RIR 4).
First set: start light; aim for a weight you could do ~4 more reps with at the top of the range. Too easy (6+ left)? Go up. Grinding? Drop.
Log the weight you finish on — that's your November week 1 weight.
Last two sessions (29–30 Oct): add a set to the first lift and leave 3 in the tank.

days.name: Day A — Chest & Triceps
days.notes: Lead-in: 2 sets each at RIR 4 — learn the lifts and find starting weights. Warm up 5 min on the rower, SkiErg or air bike first.

items.notes: Do 2–3 warm-up sets first (Tools → Warm-up). Safety arms just below chest height. 29–30 Oct: add a third set (⋯ → Add a set) at RIR 3.

days.name: Day B — Legs
days.notes: Lead-in: 2 sets each at RIR 4 — learn the lifts and find starting weights. Warm up 5 min on the rower, SkiErg or air bike first.

items.notes: Do 2–3 warm-up sets first (Tools → Warm-up). Safety arms just below your bottom position. 29–30 Oct: add a third set (⋯ → Add a set) at RIR 3.
Log only the plates you add, not the sled.

days.name: Day C — Back & Biceps
days.notes: Lead-in: 2 sets each at RIR 4 — learn the lifts and find starting weights. Warm up 5 min on the rower, SkiErg or air bike first.

items.notes: Can't get 5 clean reps yet? Swap to Cable Lat Pulldown. 29–30 Oct: add a third set (⋯ → Add a set) at RIR 3.
